svg.aria-label: A blank sheet with four stage columns and three rows: upper voice, lower voice, interval. Boxes are empty for the learner to fill in.
svg.title: Your two-voice path sheet

g.text: Write the notes and the interval at each
stage, then join the boxes to draw each
How to read this graphic: Each column is one
stage. Write the upper note in the top box
and the lower note in the lower box, then
work out the letters and semitones in the
bottom box using your own keyboard. Join the
boxes with lines to draw each voice's path.
